submission.justification: Recommend Algorithm-L1 at a 35 GeV threshold. The project candidate list includes Algorithm-L1, Algorithm-L2, and Algorithm-L3; Algorithm-L1 is the sliding-window clustering implementation with learned calibration. The allocated Level-1 rate is 8 kHz. Simulation scans at the allocated rate show Algorithm-L1 is on a broad efficiency plateau above the 80% hard requirement around 30-40 GeV; the project 2025 emulation summary gives 85% for Algorithm-L1 at 35 GeV, and my current emulation runs at/near this point were consistent with about 85% signal efficiency. Algorithm-L2 has higher simulated efficiency but is an iterative topological-clustering design and is therefore not selected for the hard 4.0 us Level-1 FPGA latency constraint; Algorithm-L3 is simpler but its simulated efficiency is below 80% at all scanned thresholds, so it fails the efficiency requirement. Thus Algorithm-L1 at 35 GeV is the highest-efficiency latency-safe choice among the viable candidates.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the highest possible signal efficiency at the allocated trigger rate.
requirements.evidence: Rate allocation document assigns 8 kHz. Simulation at the allocated rate gives Algorithm-L1 about 85% near 35 GeV (2025 summary: 85% at 35 GeV; current scans around 30-40 GeV show a broad ~85% plateau). Algorithm-L3 is <80% throughout the scan; Algorithm-L2 is not chosen because of the latency constraint.

requirements.requirement: The algorithm must be one of the three candidates listed in candidate_specs.md.
requirements.evidence: candidate_specs.md lists Algorithm-L1 as one of the three candidate algorithms: sliding-window clustering with a learned calibration.

requirements.requirement: The signal efficiency at the allocated rate must be at least 80%.
requirements.evidence: At the allocated rate, Algorithm-L1 at 35 GeV is reported as 85% in simulation_summary_2025.md; current emulation runs at 35 GeV returned 85.424%, 84.903%, 86.641%, and 84.820%, all above 80%.

requirements.requirement: The algorithm's latency on the Level-1 FPGA hardware must not exceed 4.0 us.
requirements.evidence: Algorithm-L1 is a sliding-window, single-pass/pipelineable Level-1 FPGA clustering algorithm. The iterative Algorithm-L2 was rejected as the latency-risk option; the fixed-window Algorithm-L3 is latency-safe but fails the efficiency requirement.
The recommended threshold is 35 GeV, which lies within the allowed 20-60 GeV range.

requirements.requirement: Finish by submitting one recommended algorithm and threshold.
requirements.evidence: Submitted one recommendation: Algorithm-L1 with threshold 35 GeV.
